**The Facade of Mystery**

At the very end of Sycamore Lane, where the asphalt gives way to a patch of overgrown clover, stands a house that seems to have paused time itself. It is a modest, two-story structure built of weathered gray stone and timber, its paint faded to a soft, dusty sage green that blends seamlessly with the surrounding hydrangeas.
